text:
Picture of my father.
Picture taken by Captain Kennedy with his Nikon F
Person next to my father is a prisoner they captured, who is a pasthic Lao that was turned over to the CIA.

Person face in the back that is blurred is a “striker “. 70% off strikers were enemy.
researchNotes: Larry's words relayed third-person by his son, who typed on his own @mdfmkl account during the 2026-08-15 session (Larry dictating at the table). Cataloged on VN-0023. 'Pasthic Lao' read as Pathet Lao — a Pathet Lao prisoner near Tây Ninh handed to the CIA would be a documentable event; treated as a lead. Firmly places Captain Kennedy on patrol with Larry.
